availability_evidence: Annual report pages 83 and 117 state that the Group and Company financial statements were approved and authorised by the Board on 28 February 2020; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue rose 3% to £1,110.7m, but adjusted operating profit fell 2.4% to £89.4m, adjusted profit before tax declined 5% to £78.5m and adjusted operating margin contracted 50bps to 8.0%. Boeing 737 MAX disruption led to a Group-wide restructuring programme covering headcount, overheads, work transfers and a facility closure. Free cash flow grew 29% to £58.3m and net debt fell £19.5m to £229.6m.
already_announced_exclusion: The announced Group-wide restructuring programme, South Carolina facility closure, work transfers, disposals and associated costs disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Profit and margin contraction, explicit demand disruption and broad restructuring language create substantial pressure. Revenue growth, strong free cash flow and falling debt provide material contrary evidence.

availability_evidence: Annual report pages 140 and 184 state that the Group and Company financial statements were approved and authorised by the Board on 1 March 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue increased 14% to £963.5m, adjusted profit before tax rose 91% to £38.3m and adjusted operating margin expanded 140bps to 4.8%. Free cash flow remained positive at £15.5m but fell 44%, while net debt increased £25.0m to £203.8m. Residual restructuring activity produced £5.6m of net costs, including committed plans already communicated to affected employees.
already_announced_exclusion: The communicated residual restructuring plans, impairments, site actions and associated costs disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Strong revenue, profit and margin recovery provide very strong contrary evidence. Lower free cash flow, rising debt and residual restructuring create moderate pressure.
